messages:
emily: Quick brainstorm — thinking of a short refapp mini-series (2 tutorials + one benchmark webinar) to drive dev signups. Need: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar plan, and inbound lead routing. Who can own what?

sam: Love it. I can take the launch post + social copy. Timeline?

emily: Targeting 5 weeks out. Week 0: announce mini-series + webinar save-the-date. Week 2: publish tutorial #1 + benchmark teaser. Week 3: tutorial #2 + deeper bench. Week 4: webinar + full benchmark writeup.

maria: I can do webinar ops (registrations, Zoom + recordings). Need the landing page + CTA + UTM scheme from Sam. Also +1 on gating webinar for qualified leads.

dan: I'll own the benchmark narrative + data. Plan to run a reproducible perf suite against 3 model variants and show throughput/latency tradeoffs. Need sample prompts and eval harness from DevRel.

arjun: DevRel can prep the tutorial repo and a reproducible script. I'll also add a small smoke CI so users can run the bench locally. ETA 10 days for initial repo skeleton.

emily: Nice. For inbound routing: we should map webinar registrants -> MQL -> SDR sequence if company size > X. For smaller orgs, auto-email nurture + product trial invite.

sam: Draft UTM pattern suggestion:```utm_source=refapp_series&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=quickforge_launch&utm_content={channel}``` Can we standardize across blog, social, and email?

maria: Yes — will wire those into the landing page. Also recommend a short qualifying question on the form: "Primary use case" and "Company size" so routing can be automated.

dan: For the benchmark post, headline options: "QuickForge: Small refapp, big throughput" or "Production inference patterns from a 2-file refapp". Thoughts?

emily: Go with the second — it frames practical learnings. Sam — please draft the blog + 3 tweet variants. Keep one tweet focused on the benchmark numbers as a hook.

sam: On it. Will post first draft in #marketing-drafts by EOD tomorrow.

arjun: For the repo README, can we include a "Run the bench" snippet? Example:
```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/quickforge-refkit.git
cd quickforge-refkit
./run_bench.sh --model gpt-small --seq 512 --iters 100
```
I’ll add that.

emily: Action items summarized: 1) Sam: blog + social drafts + UTM spec. 2) Dan: benchmark suite + narrative. 3) Arjun: tutorial repo + CI + run instructions. 4) Maria: landing page + registration form + routing rules. 5) Emily: checklist + announce plan. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept.

devrel-bot: Reminder: webinar asset checklist template created -> https://docs.internal/redwood/webinars/checklist

sam: ✅ accepted, will start draft.
dan: ✅ I’ll post initial bench results in 48h.
arjun: ✅ starting repo skeleton today.
maria: ✅ will share landing draft by next Tue.
emily: Great — will compile tasks in Asana and ping infra for webinar compute. Thanks everyone :rocket:
